verdict.rationale: Stripe docs explicitly name and document x402 protocol support for stablecoin payments, including a technical detail (0.01 USDC minimum), which goes beyond blog-level aspiration. However, there is no documented support for ACP, MPP, or AP2 protocols in the evidence pack, so the 'speaks the machine-payment protocols by name' story is only partially fulfilled. Missing for 10: ACP support/endpoints, MPP support/endpoints, AP2 support/endpoints, and independent corroboration of x402 usage in production.
